title: Red Hat Security Advisory: php:8.2 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: A critical security update for PHP 8.2 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux addresses multiple vulnerabilities including remote code execution, local privilege escalation, request smuggling, cross-site scripting, and denial of service. The update rebases PHP to version 8.2.36 and fixes issues such as use-after-free bugs, out-of-bounds reads/writes, and signature bypasses. These vulnerabilities affect PHP when used in various configurations including PHP-CGI and PHP-FPM. The advisory provides fixes for all identified issues and recommends applying the update to mitigate these risks.
